before.notes: Developer-authored Korean identifier contract fixed before implementing the candidate; provisional project reading policy, pending independent linguistic review. No synthesized audio. Found by reading realistic Korean notices: a digit run after an identifier cue was read as a quantity, so 우편번호 06236 became 육천이백삼십육 (losing the leading zero) and 주문번호 20260926-0001 became a range. Korean reads these digit by digit. A cue is required, so an ordinary amount keeps its cardinal reading, and the existing counter cues are untouched.
